Sins of the FatherPassive
Instant cast
Damage dealt by Horusath Blast and Rapture now applies Sins of the Father to the enemy for 8 sec.

Damage dealt by Radiant Flame or Ascended Barrage against targets affected by Sins of the Father now deals COND(GT(FireP, HolP), 54+1.0 Points Per Level+FireP*.1, 54+1.0 Points Per Level+HolP*.1) Holyfire Damage to up to 5 enemies within 5 yds.
